cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: an open gantry stairway up the side of a docked ship — standing with one foot up on a step; A quiet floating relaxation capsule above a luminous nocturnal ocean — She reaches for a drifting sleep mask after the capsule gravity gently lowers; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — standing; A transparent orbital sightseeing elevator moving above a blue planet in late morning — She watches a weightless paper souvenir spiral beside the window and gently blows it toward the glass; the stone stairway up to an old city gate tower — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; her crew cabin aboard a starship — lying on her left side; her living room with a deep sofa — holds a folded cleaning cloth at chest height; a moonlit lotus pond with stepping stones and glowing fireflies — perched on a ledge or edge; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — chest-deep in the water; a themed costume event venue with props and a photo wall — loops the strap of a camera over her head; the Wuhou Shrine in Chengdu — holds a red oil-paper umbrella open over her shoulder; a nightclub with a dance floor under moving coloured lights and a velvet-rope queue at its door — carries her keepsake low at her side
